extractedText: Request Prophecy, My Heavenly Calendar, Dream Interpretation & 101 Prophetic Activation & More!Online Ministry by Email or WhatsApp With Tony FrancisPreviousNext12Hello, I’m glad you reached this page. My name is Tony Francis, I love the prophetic ministry of the Holy Spirit and it is a gift that I have been active in for almost two decades now. I prophesied to hundreds, and thousands of people locally and worldwide. I am not a respecter of man, I serve everyone but God has anointed me specifically to pray and prophesy for celebrities, influential people, politicians, and on, this is what I am seasoned in! I also activate and mentor believers and churches in the prophetic. I had the honor to serve for a while as the prophetic leader of the web church of Apostle Patricia King.I would love to serve you with the prophetic word of the Lord which is more than revelation knowledge but a real substance and release of authority that alters your destiny. The world is framed by the word of God! (Hebrews 11:3)I am excited to position myself to pray and prophesy for you. I know you will never be the same in Jesus’ name.I want you to know that you are NOT paying for a word. God’s word is FREE! The free-will offering of any amount you desire to sow starting at a set minimum helps support the ministry, filters the number of people requesting this service, and covers the cost of the means I use to get to you. When you buy a bible, you don’t demand it to be free just because it is the word of God. God’s word by itself is free indeed but that bible costs print, cover, electricity, wages, and other expenses. Also, each format is different, an online ministry is different than an on-site one. When I minister on-site, money is not in the equation. Hope this clarifies and keeps things pure for you.The time of delivery of your prophetic word depends on what you choose. I promise you a quick response (and I have a history of being fast) but please consider that I am also having others on the list and I need to take some time to pray! Let’s trust God that you will get the prophetic word at the right time. I can’t wait to minister to you; it is my privilege. God bless you! Nothing is more beautiful than a prophetic word popping on your mobile on time encouraging and inviting you to breakthrough. Join this feature for FREE.
